verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API, webhooks, and OAuth-based public connections (notion-docs-1,3,4,10) provide the generic building blocks that a third party could use to sync status from a design tool like Figma into Notion, but there is no evidence of an official Figma/design-tool integration or plugin that lets a designer update Notion status directly from their design tool. Missing for 10: a documented design-tool-specific integration (e.g., Figma plugin), evidence of designers actually using such a workflow, and confirmation this works without custom development.
